finding.title: Route auth/onboarding validators and email-verification/no-backup UI strings through AppLocalizations instead of hardcoded English

evidence.quote:
message:
          'This account exists only on this device. '

finding.why: auth_validators.dart's validateEmail/validatePassword/validateDisplayName return raw English strings ('Email is required', 'Please enter a valid email address', 'Password is required', 'Password must be at least 6 characters', 'Display name is required'); its byte-identical live twin at lib/features/onboarding/domain/validators/auth_validators.dart is wired as the TextFormField validator in both signup_screen.dart:75-81 and sign_in_screen.dart:404 — every Hebrew-locale user sees these in English on the two most-visited auth screens. email_verification_confirm_panel.dart unconditionally hardcodes 'Open Email', 'Send Again', 'Cancel' as button text (no l10n parameter exists for them at all) and defaults title/verifiedLinkLabel to English; email_verification_dialog.dart — the only production call site, reached from sign_in_controller.dart's real verification flow — never overrides `title`, so 'Confirm Your Email' always renders in English. no_backup_badge.dart hardcodes both its Tooltip message and its Semantics(label:) in English, so even the screen-reader announcement for this always-visible local-account badge is untranslated. Notably 'Cancel' duplicates an ARB key (`cancel`) already used elsewhere in this exact feature (account_picker_screen.dart's dialog), so the fix for that string is a one-line change, not new-key work.
finding.recommendation: Add ARB keys (EN+HE) for 'Open Email'/'Send Again'/panel title/no-backup tooltip+semantics; thread AppLocalizations into the validator functions (or return stable EH-5 error codes resolved via ARB at the call site) instead of literal strings; pass `title:` and button-label params through from callers using existing/added l10n keys.
acceptance_criteria: A widget test pumping signup_screen.dart / sign_in_screen.dart / EmailVerificationConfirmPanel / NoBackupBadge under Locale('he') asserts no literal English fallback string is rendered
make arb-parity-style or a new grep-based Rule-0 checker flags string literals inside Text()/Tooltip(message:)/Semantics(label:) under lib/features/**/presentation/**
